page_title: PSG 3-0 MET | PSG v Metz 21/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+2' The PSG players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
90+1' Ibrahim Mbaye (PSG) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
88' A substitution has been made. Georgiy Tsitaishvili goes off and Nathan Mbala (Metz) comes on.
88' The ball possession at the moment is 67:33.
84' PSG have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
83' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from PSG was in an offside position.
82' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
80' PSG can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
80' Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) receives a great pass inside the box and misses a golden chance. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save. PSG get a corner.
78' Here comes a substitution. Alpha Toure is given a rest as he is replaced by Giorgi Kvilitaia (Metz).
77' 3 - 0 Goncalo Ramos (PSG) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Jonathan Fischer with a strike into the top left corner. He makes it 3:0.
74' Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
74' Bouna Sarr (Metz) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
72' PSG control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
68' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) fires a shot well wide of the right post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
66' Benoit Tavenot has decided to substitute Fode Ballo-Toure and he is replaced by Jessy Deminguet (Metz).
66' Benoit Tavenot decides to make a substitution. Lucas Michal will be replaced by Bouna Sarr (Metz).
66' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Giorgi Abuashvili (Metz) will replace Koffi Kouao.

65' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. PSG are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
64' It is time for a substitution. Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) is on for Bradley Barcola.
63' Luis Enrique has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Vitinha (PSG) replacing Kang-In Lee.
63' It's time for a substitution. Joao Neves (PSG) comes on in place of Dro Fernandez.
62' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 9:2.
58' One of the players from PSG times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
55' Bradley Barcola (PSG) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
51' Metz take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
49' PSG enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
46' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Desire Doue (PSG) leaves the pitch to be replaced by Ibrahim Mbaye.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' 2 - 0 Goal! The corner is whipped in and Bradley Barcola (PSG) is in the right place at the right time, planting his header perfectly into the right side of the goal. He makes it 2:0.
45+3' The ball is out of play. PSG will have a chance to score from a corner.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Boubacar Traore (Metz) was quite harsh and Abdelatif Kherradji didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
42' Lucas Michal (Metz) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
40' The number of shots on goal at present is 2:0.
40' Bradley Barcola (PSG) is having a lively performance. He is causing problems and wanting the ball at every opportunity.
39' Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Matvey Safonov, who smothers the ball.
36' PSG are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
32' Close! Achraf Hakimi (PSG) takes the resulting free kick from a promising positon, but his effort flies inches wide of the right post.
31' Jean-Philippe Gbamin (Metz) earns the yellow card.
31' Confusion here but it seems that referee Abdelatif Kherradji has changed his mind following the VAR review and downgraded the red card shown to Jean-Philippe Gbamin (Metz) to a yellow.
30' Referee Abdelatif Kherradji is going to consult VAR for a possible red card infringement after that scuffle between the two teams, as it’s not immediately clear who the culprit was.
29' PSG are awarded a free kick on the edge of the box.
28' The game is interrupted. Lucas Beraldo (PSG) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
25' Bradley Barcola (PSG) makes a run into the box in an attempt to get onto a long through ball, but one of the opponents comes up with a vital clearance.
23' The ratio of the ball possession is 68:32.
21' Dro Fernandez (PSG) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Jonathan Fischer.
19' Koffi Kouao (Metz) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
16' The linesman signals that Lucas Michal (Metz) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
14' The PSG players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
13' Bradley Barcola (PSG) plays a through ball but overhits it.
9' Lucas Beraldo (PSG) brings his opponent down. Abdelatif Kherradji has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
8' The resulting set piece from PSG is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
7' Bradley Barcola (PSG) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but he misses the right post by a whisker.

3' 1 - 0 Goal! Great play by Warren Zaire-Emery releases Desire Doue (PSG) in space on the edge of the box. He spots the keeper off his line and coolly puts the ball into the left side of the goal. 1:0.
2' Metz are ruled offside.
1' The first half has started.
